alias: Weather - Warning Alert on the Screens
description: A new Bureau warning for the district (sheep graziers skipped) turns on input_boolean.weather_warning_alert, which puts it full screen on the Kitchen Display and the Echo until someone taps Got it. The alert goes off by itself once no warning is left. No phone notifications.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] and trigger.to_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] }}

variables.new: {% set old = (trigger.from_state.attributes.warnings or []) | map(attribute='id') | list %}{% set skip = ['sheep_graziers_warning'] %}{% set ns = namespace(out=[]) %}{% for w in trigger.to_state.attributes.warnings or [] %}{% if w.id not in old and w.type not in skip %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + [w] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.out }}
variables.live: {% set skip = ['sheep_graziers_warning'] %}{{ (trigger.to_state.attributes.warnings or []) | rejectattr('type', 'in', skip) | list | count }}
